stem:
On Saturday Kai gave his guinea pig 80 grams of food. The table shows the amount of each type of food he gave to the guinea pig.

Guinea Pig Food

| Type of Food     | Amount of Food (grams) | Key for Bar Graph |
|-----------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| Hay             | 40                    | [white square]    |
| Alfalfa pellets | 20                    | [light gray square]|
| Tomatoes        | 10                    | [medium gray square]|
| Lettuce         | 10                    | [dark gray square] |

Which percentage bar graph best represents the data?
visual_elements: Table showing Type of Food, Amount of Food (grams), and Key for Bar Graph with colors for Hay (40g, white), Alfalfa pellets (20g, light gray), Tomatoes (10g, medium gray), Lettuce (10g, dark gray).

Four horizontal bar graphs labeled F, G, H, J representing Guinea Pig Food as colored segments on scales from 0% to 100% showing different proportional distributions of colors white, light gray, medium gray, dark gray.
notes: The problem involves matching given food amounts to the correct proportional bar graph in percentage form.
